audit_items.proof_trace: STEM_BOT_API_BEARER_TOKEN lacks the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, so Next.js never bundles it into client JS. All token-reading sites reside in files marked 'use server' (members.ts, teams.ts, generations.ts) or in Server Components (dashboard/page.tsx), and no return value on any path includes the token — it is consumed only as an outgoing Authorization header to the bot API. No API route handlers (src/app/api/**) reference the token, and next.config.ts has no env: block that could re-expose it.
